options.systemMessage: You are a risk manager assistant for a commercial property owner. You write a clear, concise weekly compliance digest. No markdown, no emojis.

parameters.content:
## 08-17-04 track vendor insurance certificates and renewal reminders

### How it works

A certificate of insurance (COI) email arrives in the monitored mailbox and is validated. An AI agent extracts the policy details from the email body, then the workflow checks the coverage limits, additional insured status and expiry date against your requirements. Compliant certificates are logged to the COI Registry sheet and the vendor gets a confirmation email. Certificates with gaps or that are about to expire trigger a personalized renewal request to the vendor, a Discord alert for the team and a Telegram alert for the most urgent cases. A daily sweep reads the registry and emails reminders to every vendor expiring within 45 days. Every Monday a digest with compliance stats and an AI written summary is emailed and posted on Discord.

### Setup steps

- Open the Google Sheet, connect it to a Google Sheets credential and keep the COI Registry and ReminderLog tabs.
- Connect a Gmail credential and set the Gmail trigger to poll the mailbox that receives COI emails, or forward COI emails there.
- Connect a Discord bot credential for team alerts and a Telegram bot credential for critical alerts.
- Set the required coverage limits and reminder windows in the Compute Compliance Status and Compute Renewal Needs nodes.
- Adjust the daily sweep and weekly digest schedules to your operation.

### Customization

- Change the coverage requirements (limits, workers comp, additional insured) in Compute Compliance Status.
- Send critical alerts to Slack, WhatsApp or SMS by swapping the Telegram node.
- Add a PDF attachment download step before the AI extraction to read actual COI documents.

## Email intake and AI parsing

COI emails are picked up by the Gmail trigger, validated, and parsed into structured policy data by the AI agent.

## Compliance scoring and alerts

Coverage limits, additional insured and expiry are checked. Gaps, expiring and expired certificates get a vendor email, a Discord alert and a Telegram alert when critical.

## Daily renewal sweep

Every morning the registry is checked. Vendors expiring within 45 days get a reminder email and the team sees a summary on Discord, or an all clear.

## Weekly compliance digest

Every Monday the workflow computes compliance stats and an AI write-up that is emailed and posted on Discord.
